analysis: The trial succeeded operationally and achieved host validation macro HR@10 of 0.5037: +0.0037 over the reported uniform-weight predecessor (0.5000), but −0.0013 below baseline (0.5050). Category HR@10 was 0.550 Movies_and_TV, 0.535 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.380 Electronics, and 0.550 CDs_and_Vinyl. Eight-transition recency weighting produced a modest aggregate improvement, missing the hypothesized 0.510–0.520 range. Electronics remained the weakest category. These results do not establish causality or statistical significance; predecessor category scores were not supplied. Allocated GPU time was 528.62 seconds.
code_summary: One independently trained SASRec model per category: 96-dimensional embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks, two attention heads, dropout 0.2, and a jointly trained causal history-attention pooling branch fused through a learned gate. Scoring uses normalized embeddings, learned temperature, and item bias. Sampled-softmax training selects up to 24 transitions uniformly, applies eight-transition half-life weights, and normalizes loss within each history before averaging histories equally. Training retains 256 sampled negatives, training-history exclusion masks, prefix augmentation, AdamW, cosine learning-rate decay, and validation checkpoint selection. Prediction routes each category to exactly one selected checkpoint; no ensemble or separately fitted scorer is used.
